notes: Behavioral oracle: the exact R14 archive and commit recorded above. The cumulative Python implementation through PR #189 is preserved under draft #192. Native R14 overlays are explicit and hashed separately; extern/NNS-core remains byte-for-byte at the recorded accepted vendor revision. The vendored tools/NNS snapshot, r_src_tree_hash, and tools/NNS_13.0.tar.gz retain their historical lineage and do not identify the live R14 behavioral oracle. Local verification results are recorded in docs/R14_LOCAL_PARITY_REPAIR.md; remote CI/release approval is separate.

r14_native_overlays.adaptation: R14 gravity/mode port with std::vector marshalling. CMake replaces only the old central-tendency translation unit; vendor rescale behavior is retained.

R14 multilevel/null-corrected dependence with vector marshalling. R::dhyper and R::pnorm are the ports of R's own nmath routines in src/nns/_rnmath.hpp, so the null expectations match R's bit for bit. Bound explicitly instead of the untouched vendor dependence estimator.

The vendored NNS-core multivariate prediction kernel (src/mreg_predict.cpp, sha256 c98d3fbb93c3165109870cb3d2cc1a55c8cb0fa35770b3ff0204441fd20e1e04) with its Student-t and normal ensemble weights evaluated by R's own nmath dt and dnorm4 (src/nns/_rnmath.hpp) instead of the vendor's lgamma-based closed form, so the weights and predictions match R's NNS_mreg_predict_v2_cpp bit for bit. CMake replaces only the vendor translation unit.

r_cache_summary.generation: Pinned live R 14.0 only; no Python-authored expected values.
